fieldDescription:
Sets how much the Flotilla produces.
- Auto: Survival in a Survival Mode game, and Normal otherwise.
- Survival: no bonuses. The Flotilla sustains itself but has little surplus.
- Normal: global efficiency is multiplied by 1.25, and Basic Needs requires 20%% less Space and residents.
- Story: everything Normal gives, and global efficiency is multiplied by another 1.25, Basic Needs requires another 20%% less, and stored commodities take up half the Space.

In a Survival Mode game, the Fuel Plant needs more volatiles, the Brokerage sells goods for less, and the autoforge builds everything at Survival Mode's prices, but the Foundry makes more Foundry production a month. Turn this off to keep the normal values.

Manage this mod through an intel screen entry instead of its own Management bar button (for mod compatibility). If you don't see the manage button at the bottom, try turning this on. Takes effect on the next game load.

Press Escape while picking a key to clear it. A key the game already uses outside of combat is ignored. Other mods may have this setting, and if more than one is changed, the first in the Manage tab row wins. Takes effect on the next game load.
Global multiplier on all onboard production.
Multiplier on autoforge yield in particular (affects both inputs and outputs).

Compounding population growth at Normal Basic Needs. 0.02 = 2 percent per cycle. The population grows faster at the levels above Normal, in proportion. Most growth comes from migrant pickups or crew you manually move to the Flotilla.
How long before a colony offers the Flotilla migrants again.
Whether the Flotilla status bar appears at the top of the campaign map.
Multiplies the OP cost of every Nomad hullmod.
Ships with a Nomad hullmod have -15%% top speed.
Ships with a Nomad hullmod have -15%% rate of fire.
Ships with a Nomad hullmod have -15%% maximum combat readiness.
